container.definition:
Bootstrap: docker
From: rockylinux:9

%files
    site-ca-bundle.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/pw-site-ca.crt

%post
    # the login node's CA bundle, added to the image's trust store: a site whose
    # proxy re-signs HTTPS is trusted by dnf, curl and everything else
    update-ca-trust
    dnf install -y --setopt=install_weak_deps=False gcc && dnf clean all
    mkdir -p /opt/hello
    printf '%s\n' '#include <stdio.h>' 'int main(void) { puts("hello from a program compiled in the container"); return 0; }' > /opt/hello/hello.c
    gcc -O2 -o /opt/hello/hello /opt/hello/hello.c

%runscript
    exec /opt/hello/hello

%test
    /opt/hello/hello
